```{r setup, warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())
set.seed(3459)
setwd("~/projects/thesis_scripts/figure_scripts/winlose_reveal/")
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(patchwork)
library(svglite)
library(viridis)
library(colorspace)

source("../../src/neuron_smoothing.R")
source("../../src/figs.R")

monkey_fill_pal <- scale_fill_manual(values = c("royalblue", "darkorange"), labels = c("Monkey U", "Monkey V"), guide = FALSE)
monkey_col_pal <- scale_colour_manual(values = c("royalblue", "darkorange"), labels = c("Monkey U", "Monkey V"), guide = FALSE)

neuronal_data <- bind_rows(
  readRDS("../../data/neurons/onefrac_noerror_neuronal_data.rds"),
  readRDS("../../data/neurons/threefrac_noerror_neuronal_data.rds"),
)
task_data <- readRDS("../../data/neurons/task_data.rds")

cell_baselines_fractals <-
  readRDS("../../data/baseline/cell_prefc_baselines_fractals_smoothed.rds")
cell_baselines_fractal_counts <-
  readRDS("../../data/baseline/cell_prefc_baselines_fractals.rds")
cell_baselines_counts <-
  readRDS("../../data/baseline/cell_prefc_baselines.rds")

sigcells_uly <-
  read_csv("../../data/cells/uly_sig_cells.csv") %>%
  mutate(monkey = "Monkey U") %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date, "%d-%b-%y"))
sigcells_vice <-
  read_csv("../../data/cells/vice_sig_cells.csv") %>%
  mutate(monkey = "Monkey V") %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date, "%d-%b-%Y"))

sigcells <-
  bind_rows(sigcells_uly, sigcells_vice) %>%
  mutate(cell = paste0("cell", gsub("^(Clust)([0-9])(_.*)$", "\\2", cluster)))

monkey_windows <- read_csv("../../data/config/monkey_windows.csv")
configs <- read_csv("../../data/config/configs.csv")

group_cols <- c("date", "monkey", "cell")
group_cols_fractal <- c(group_cols, "fractal_value")

relevant_cells <- sigcells %>%
  select(date, monkey, cell, isDA, isResponsive, numTrGood, DAFracResponsive, DAWinloseResponsive) %>%
  filter(isDA == 1 & isResponsive == 1 & numTrGood == 1) %>%
  distinct(date, monkey, cell, .keep_all = TRUE)

n_start <- filter(configs, var == "neurons_start") %>% pull(value)
n_end <- filter(configs, var == "neurons_end") %>% pull(value)
smooth_window <-
  filter(configs, var == "smooth_window") %>% pull(value)
```

```{r monkey_bid_baselines}
pre_start <- -400
pre_end <- -50

winlose_task_data <- task_data %>%
  filter(situation %in% c(1, 2, 3)) %>%
  filter(map_lgl(error_bit, ~ is.na(unlist(.x)))) %>%
  select(date, monkey, trial, fractal_value, monkey_bid, computer_bid) %>%
  distinct(date, monkey, trial, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(monkey_bid < computer_bid) %>%
  # mutate(
  #   monkey_bid_ntile = case_when(
  #     monkey_bid <= 20 ~ "lowest",
  #     monkey_bid <= 40 ~ "low",
  #     monkey_bid <= 60 ~ "medium",
  #     monkey_bid <= 80 ~ "high",
  #     monkey_bid <= 100 ~ "highest"
  #   )
  # ) %>%
  mutate(
    monkey_bid_ntile = case_when(
      monkey_bid <= 34 ~ "low",
      monkey_bid <= 67 ~ "medium",
      monkey_bid <= 100 ~ "high"
    )
  ) %>%
  # mutate(monkey_bid_ntile = factor(monkey_bid_ntile, levels = c("lowest", "low", "medium", "high", "highest")))
  mutate(monkey_bid_ntile = factor(monkey_bid_ntile, levels = c("low", "medium", "high")))

winlose_data <- neuronal_data %>%
  filter(situation %in% c(1, 2, 3)) %>%
  filter(map_lgl(bits, function(x) {
    if (!is.null(x) && is.data.frame(x) && nrow(x) > 0) {
      matching_rows <- x$names == "win_lose" & x$index == "upat"
      sum(matching_rows) == 1 && !is.na(x$vals[matching_rows])
    } else {
      FALSE
    }
  }))  %>%
  unnest(bits) %>%
  filter(names == "win_lose" & index == "upat") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = names, values_from = vals)

winlose_spikes <- winlose_data %>%
  inner_join(winlose_task_data, by = c("date", "monkey", "trial")) %>%
  unnest(sorted_spikes) %>%
  mutate(spike_bit_time_ms = trial_spike_time_ms - win_lose) %>%
  select(date,
         monkey,
         trial,
         cell,
         spike_bit_time_ms,
         fractal_value,
         monkey_bid_ntile,
         monkey_bid,
         computer_bid) %>%
  mutate(monkey_win = monkey_bid > computer_bid)

win_baselines <- winlose_spikes %>%
  filter(spike_bit_time_ms >= pre_start &
           spike_bit_time_ms <= pre_end) %>%
  select(date, monkey, cell, monkey_bid_ntile, spike_bit_time_ms) %>%
  group_by(date, monkey, cell, monkey_bid_ntile) %>%
  group_split() %>%
  map_df(get_baseline_params, w = smooth_window, t = pre_start:pre_end)

win_smoothed <- winlose_spikes %>%
  filter(spike_bit_time_ms >= n_start &
           spike_bit_time_ms <= n_end) %>%
  inner_join(relevant_cells  %>% filter(DAWinloseResponsive == 1), by = group_cols) %>%
  select(date, monkey, cell, monkey_bid_ntile, spike_bit_time_ms) %>%
  nest(vector = spike_bit_time_ms) %>%
  left_join(win_baselines, by = c(group_cols, "monkey_bid_ntile")) %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(c(
    group_cols, "monkey_bid_ntile"
  )))) %>%
  group_split() %>%
  map_df(smooth_data, start = n_start, end = n_end, 100) %>%
  group_by(monkey, t, monkey_bid_ntile) %>%
  summarise(
    av_zscore = mean(z_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_zscore = sd(z_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "keep"
  ) %>%
  mutate(sem = sd_zscore / sqrt(n))

p_loss_reveal <-
  ggplot(
    win_smoothed %>% filter(
      t > filter(configs, var == "fig_start") %>% pull(value) &
        t < filter(configs, var == "fig_end") %>% pull(value)
    ),
    aes(x = t, y = av_zscore, colour = monkey_bid_ntile)
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    data = monkey_windows,
    aes(
      xmin = window_start,
      xmax = window_end,
      ymin = -Inf,
      ymax = Inf
    ),
    fill = "grey",
    alpha = 0.5,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_colour_viridis_d(name = "monkey bid tercile") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
  facet_wrap( ~ monkey, scales = "free") +
  population_firing_fig_theme(
    filter(configs, var == "fig_start") %>% pull(value),
    filter(configs, var == "fig_end") %>% pull(value),
    "win/ lose reveal"
  )

```

```{r linear_model, warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
ntiles = 25

winlose_task_data <- task_data %>%
  filter(situation %in% c(1, 2, 3)) %>%
  filter(monkey_bid < computer_bid) %>%
  filter(monkey_bid > 0) %>%
  select(date, monkey, session, trial, fractal_value, monkey_bid, computer_bid) %>%
  mutate(
    monkey_bid_ntiles = cut(
      monkey_bid,
      breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 100/ntiles),
      labels = FALSE,
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(monkey, monkey_bid_ntiles) %>%
  filter(n() > 10)

relevant_cells_ntiles <- merge(
  relevant_cells  %>% filter(DAWinloseResponsive == 1) %>% select(all_of(group_cols)),
  winlose_task_data %>% select(monkey, monkey_bid_ntiles) %>% distinct(),
  by = "monkey",
  all = TRUE
)

wl_spike_data <- neuronal_data %>%
  filter(situation %in% c(1,2,3)) %>%
  filter(map_lgl(bits, function(x) {
    if (!is.null(x) && is.data.frame(x) && nrow(x) > 0) {
      matching_rows <- x$names == "win_lose" & x$index == "upat"
      sum(matching_rows) == 1 && !is.na(x$vals[matching_rows])
    } else {
      FALSE
    }
  }))  %>%
  unnest(bits) %>%
  filter(names == "win_lose" & index == "upat")

wl_spikes <- wl_spike_data %>%
  inner_join(winlose_task_data, by = c("date", "monkey", "session", "trial")) %>%
  select(date, monkey, session, trial, monkey_bid_ntiles, wl_time = vals, sorted_spikes) %>%
  unnest(sorted_spikes) %>%
  mutate(spike_bit_time_ms = trial_spike_time_ms - wl_time) 

wl_spikes_ntiles <- wl_spikes %>%
  group_by(date, monkey, cell, session, trial, monkey_bid_ntiles) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(spike_bit_time_ms >= 50 & spike_bit_time_ms <= 550), .groups = "drop") %>%
  right_join(relevant_cells_ntiles, by = c(group_cols, "monkey_bid_ntiles")) %>%
  mutate(n = replace_na(n ,0)) 

baselines <- cell_baselines_counts %>%
  inner_join(relevant_cells, by = group_cols) %>%
  group_by(date, monkey, cell, trial) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(spike_bit_time_ms >= -500 & spike_bit_time_ms <= 0), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(adj_n = n) %>%
  group_by(date, monkey, cell) %>%
  summarise(mean_n = mean(adj_n), sd_n = sd(adj_n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(sd_n != 0)

wl_normalised_spikes <- wl_spikes_ntiles %>%
  left_join(baselines, by = group_cols) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(norm_n = (n - mean_n) / sd_n) %>%
  group_by(monkey, monkey_bid_ntiles) %>%
  summarise(mean_n_s = mean(norm_n), sem = sd(norm_n) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(monkey_bid_perc = monkey_bid_ntiles / ntiles) %>%
  filter(!is.na(sem))

p_loss_norm_regression <- ggplot(wl_normalised_spikes, aes(x = monkey_bid_perc, y = mean_n_s, colour = monkey, group = monkey)) + 
  stat_smooth(method = "lm") +
  geom_point(size = 2) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_n_s - sem, ymax = mean_n_s + sem), width = 0) +
  monkey_col_pal +
  labs(
    x = "monkey bid percentage",
    y = "normalised firing rate (impulses/s)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~ monkey, scales = "free_y") +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

```

```{r pop_kruskal_fractal_lose}
library(dunn.test)
fractal_reveal_results <- winlose_spikes %>%
 filter(!monkey_win) %>%
 mutate(window = case_when(
   spike_bit_time_ms >= -600 & spike_bit_time_ms <= -100 ~ "baseline",
   spike_bit_time_ms >= 0 & spike_bit_time_ms <= 500 ~ "response",
   TRUE ~ NA_character_
 )) %>%
 filter(!is.na(window)) %>%
 group_by(monkey, trial, cell, fractal_value, window) %>%
 summarize(spike_count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
 mutate(duration_ms = case_when(
   window == "baseline" ~ (-100 - -600),
   window == "response" ~ (500 - 0)
 ),
 firing_rate = 1000 * spike_count / duration_ms) %>%
 pivot_wider(
   id_cols = c(monkey, trial, cell, fractal_value),
   names_from = window,
   values_from = firing_rate
 ) %>%
 group_by(monkey, fractal_value) %>%
 summarize(
   n_pairs = n(),
   wilcox_test = list(wilcox.test(response, baseline, paired = TRUE)),
   p_value = wilcox_test[[1]]$p.value,
   baseline_mean = mean(baseline, na.rm = TRUE),
   response_mean = mean(response, na.rm = TRUE),
   mean_difference = response_mean - baseline_mean,
   .groups = "drop"
 ) %>%
 mutate(test = "pop diff from zero: fractal values") %>%
 select(monkey, fractal_value, test, p_value, mean_difference)

print(fractal_reveal_results)

fractal_reveal_difference <- winlose_spikes %>%
 filter(!monkey_win) %>%
 mutate(window = case_when(
   spike_bit_time_ms >= -600 & spike_bit_time_ms <= -100 ~ "baseline",
   spike_bit_time_ms >= 0 & spike_bit_time_ms <= 500 ~ "response",
   TRUE ~ NA_character_
 )) %>%
 filter(!is.na(window)) %>%
 group_by(monkey, trial, cell, fractal_value, window) %>%
 summarize(spike_count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
 mutate(duration_ms = 500,
        firing_rate = 1000 * spike_count / duration_ms) %>%
 pivot_wider(
   id_cols = c(monkey, trial, cell, fractal_value),
   names_from = window,
   values_from = firing_rate
 ) %>%
 mutate(change = response - baseline)

fractal_kw_results <- fractal_reveal_difference %>%
 group_by(monkey) %>%
 summarize(
   fractal_kw_test = list(kruskal.test(change ~ factor(fractal_value))),
   p_value = fractal_kw_test[[1]]$p.value,
   .groups = "drop"
 ) %>%
 mutate(test = "fractal value: high/medium/low") %>%
 select(monkey, test, p_value)

print(fractal_kw_results)

monkey_u_data <- filter(fractal_reveal_difference, monkey == "Monkey U")
dunn.test(monkey_u_data$change, factor(monkey_u_data$fractal_value, 
                                      levels = c(1, 2, 3), 
                                      labels = c("low", "medium", "high")), 
         method = "bonferroni", kw = TRUE)

monkey_v_data <- filter(fractal_reveal_difference, monkey == "Monkey V")
dunn.test(monkey_v_data$change, factor(monkey_v_data$fractal_value, 
                                      levels = c(1, 2, 3), 
                                      labels = c("low", "medium", "high")), 
         method = "bonferroni", kw = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)

wl_spikes_full <- wl_spike_data %>%
  inner_join(winlose_task_data, by = c("date", "monkey", "session", "trial")) %>%
  select(date, monkey, session, trial, monkey_bid, computer_bid, wl_time = vals, sorted_spikes) %>%
  unnest(sorted_spikes) %>%
  mutate(spike_bit_time_ms = trial_spike_time_ms - wl_time)

wl_spikes_trial <- wl_spikes_full %>%
  inner_join(relevant_cells %>% filter(DAWinloseResponsive == 1) %>% select(all_of(group_cols)), by = group_cols) %>%
  group_by(date, monkey, cell, session, trial, monkey_bid, computer_bid) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(spike_bit_time_ms >= 50 & spike_bit_time_ms <= 550), .groups = "drop")

wl_trial_level <- wl_spikes_trial %>%
  left_join(baselines, by = group_cols) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(
    norm_n = (n - mean_n) / sd_n,
    monkey_bid_perc = monkey_bid / 100,
    computer_bid_perc = computer_bid / 100,
    cell_id = paste(date, monkey, cell, sep = "_")
  )

me_results_wl_bid <- wl_trial_level %>%
  group_by(monkey) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    m <- lmer(norm_n ~ monkey_bid_perc + (1|cell_id), data = .x, REML = FALSE)
    ct <- coef(summary(m))
    tibble(
      intercept    = ct["(Intercept)", "Estimate"],
      intercept_se = ct["(Intercept)", "Std. Error"],
      slope        = ct["monkey_bid_perc", "Estimate"],
      slope_se     = ct["monkey_bid_perc", "Std. Error"],
      t_value      = ct["monkey_bid_perc", "t value"],
      p_value      = ct["monkey_bid_perc", "Pr(>|t|)"]
    )
  })

me_results_wl_cb <- wl_trial_level %>%
  group_by(monkey) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    m <- lmer(norm_n ~ computer_bid_perc + (1|cell_id), data = .x, REML = FALSE)
    ct <- coef(summary(m))
    tibble(
      intercept    = ct["(Intercept)", "Estimate"],
      intercept_se = ct["(Intercept)", "Std. Error"],
      slope        = ct["computer_bid_perc", "Estimate"],
      slope_se     = ct["computer_bid_perc", "Std. Error"],
      t_value      = ct["computer_bid_perc", "t value"],
      p_value      = ct["computer_bid_perc", "Pr(>|t|)"]
    )
  })

print(me_results_wl_bid)
print(me_results_wl_cb)
```
